patterns.note: The site employs a stark, high-contrast dark mode aesthetic with a black background and white text, creating a gallery-like presentation for its typographic content.

The primary design language revolves around showcasing a diverse range of experimental and highly stylized display typefaces, using them as prominent graphic elements for section headings and product previews.
A minimalist black and white base is consistently punctuated by vibrant, pure primary colors (red, green, blue) used as strong graphic accents within content blocks and imagery.

The hero section features a large, abstract white graphic that subtly scales and moves at a different rate than the accompanying introductory text, creating a gentle parallax effect on initial scroll.

Major content sections are introduced by oversized, graphically treated headings that often incorporate the experimental typefaces, followed by structured content blocks like two-column grids of product cards or article previews.

technique_notes: The site maintains a persistent dark mode theme, utilizing a black background with white text for high readability and a dramatic aesthetic, accented by bold primary colors within graphic elements.
A fixed navigation bar appears at the top of the viewport after a short initial scroll, providing continuous access to main site sections.

The hero section implements a subtle parallax effect where a large, abstract graphic element scales down and moves slightly faster than the introductory text as the user scrolls, adding depth to the initial view.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extreme contrast with oversized, often graphic-like display headings (up to ~8x body) and small, legible body text.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its unapologetic and extensive use of highly experimental, often pixelated or abstract display typography as a core design element, not just for branding but as the very product being showcased. This creates a unique, almost art-gallery-like experience for a type foundry.
